title: Equilibrium™ Restoring Essence
descriptionHtml:
✓ allure 2021 Best of Beauty Award Winner✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Hydrating✓ Without Sulfates SLS & SLES
What it is: An essence that conditions, protects, and restores visible balance and radiance to your skin while increasing the effectiveness of your next skincare steps.

Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily

Skincare Concerns: Dryness

Formulation: Liquid

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Cell Balancing Complex™: Visibly rebalances, restores, and renews the skin barrier.
- Pollution Shield Complex: Protects skin from environmental pollutants.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, mineral oil, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. It is also vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Pour a small amount onto your fingertips and then press into cleansed skin.
-Allow to fully absorb before applying your serum and moisturizer.
-Dry patches may require an additional application.
-Avoid contact with eyes.
-Use in the morning and evening.
Ingredients+
Water/Aqua, Butylene Glycol, Pentylene Glycol, Phenoxyethanol, Ectoin, Xanthan Gum, Sodium Citrate, Alteromonas Ferment Extract, Glycerin, Citric Acid, Capryloyl Glycine, Gluconolactone, Sodium Benzoate, Calcium Pca, Calcium Gluconate, Phospholipids, Lecithin, Sodium Hyaluronate.

Ingredient lists and claims may change or vary from time to time as part of Hourglass’s commitment to innovation and maintaining global compliance. Please refer to the ingredient list on the product packaging you receive to ensure the ingredients are suitable for your personal use.
